values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are not permitted at DEC campgrounds. One-night reservation minimum. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

note: DEC (Adirondack), Au Sable Forks, on a dirt road; primitive. Some sites on Taylor Pond; the interior sites are boat access only (rowboats and canoes rented at the campground). RV Life unrated. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $16 + $5 non-resident, 1-night minimum and phone 518-647-5250 (DEC 2026 summary), RA booking (9 months), 2027 season May 14-Sep 5, no hookups, primitive (outhouses, spigots, no showers); sites 30->31 with 24 drive-in (7 at 30 ft).
